PathOfBuilding.Notes:
You can find more Information on RF by visiting my Website ---> Pohx.net
REGEX for lvling ---> "-\w-.-|b-b-b|r-r-g|r-g-r|g-r-r|nne|rint|pup|lap|Earn" This is used in the Search bar in vendors to help highlight useful items in the early game, such as 3x blue link, INT gear for your skills & 4 links you'll find later. You don't want to purchase everything that highlights
For Early mapping I usually put RF in my Gloves/Boots/Helm so I can use a PURE Arm body till I go^xAF6025 cloak of flame^7. This is because trying to off color a pure Armour can be difficult in the early stages. If you have an early^xAF6025 cloak of flame^7 or a 5/6L you can just ignore this.
You can expect to start running RF in Act II. You want to make sure you do the ruby ring Recipe (Iron Ring + Red Gem) You want a minimum of 120 Fire Res, the more the better as you combine this with the Fire Resistance Mastery "^xB97123Regenerate 1 Life Per second per uncapped fire resistance^7" This means the number in the " "
Around Lvl 61-80 You'll be swapping ^4^7Swapping ^x7070FFPurity of Elements^7 ^7 to ^1^xB97123Purity of Fire^7 + ^x70FF70Skitterbot^7s. ^7This does require you to unlock "Brine King" Pantheon for the Freeze Immune. This is because when you drop purity of elements you will lose your Freeze Immune
At Around Level 80-90 You Should consider going "^x8888FF^x70FF70Block Based^7^7" Refer to the Loadout section in the top right for more information. You're going to want to craft a "^xE05030Shaper Shield^7" with Pristine Life Fossils or Harvest Reforge Life
Around the same time as going block you can also aim for "^xB97123Fan the Flames^7" This is an extremely important cluster jewel to help chain your Chieftain Explosions. Refer to the Loadout with "^xB97123Fan the Flames^7" You can also use Eldritch Embers to try to get Ignite Spread on your Gloves, although this is usually much more expensive.
One of the nice benefits of Chieftain is being able to just Stack Fire Resistance. The only other resist you'll look out for is Chaos Resistance.
I prefer to run a different Aura setup than my PoB just for lvling. It focuses more on damage, I run Malevolence, Skitty & Flesh n Stone
^xAF6025What Bandits do I help/Kill^7^xAF6025? ^7Helping Kraityn is what I'll do for 8% Movement Speed Helping Oak is advisible for newer players for 40 Bonus life Killing all Bandits is the best option for Single target since it offers you a skill point ^7 ^xB97123What auras to use in Campaign?^7 In the very early acts we'll be using Vitality, Later in Act 3 We'll gain Access to ^x7070FFPurity of Elements^7 & ^xAF6025^xE05030Determination^7^7. Use the Purity of Elements and hold the Determ till once you pickup the Auras Reservation nodes. After securing Freeze Immunity on the Panthon we'll drop Purity of Elements in Favor of Purity of Fire & Skitterbots.
Rare Jewels usually end up being expensive, remember you can look for many different combinations. I'll list some usable stats you can mix and match to save currency ^xB97123Prefix^7 Life, Fire Damage ^xB97123Suffix^7 Increased Damage, Fire damage over time multiplier, damage over time multiplier, area damage, burning damage, chaos resistance, dexterity,
^xB97123Which Large Cluster Jewels^7^xB97123 to use?^7 Anything with Prismatic heart or Burning bright in the front. You can also opt out for 12 Passsive clusters and try to craft them for stats like + Life & Chaos Res with Increased effect.
^xB97123Which Medium Cluster Jewels^7 ^xAF6025to use?^7 Flow of life + Any combination
As a reminder, Golems usually start to fall off in Yellow maps, they will repeatedly die as you get into higher content, I suspect a similar fate to the Animate Guardian.
